title: Customer Lifetime Value: Why the First Sale Isn't the Whole Story
summary: ORANGE-L2-005: Customer Lifetime Value: Why the First Sale Isn't the Whole Story.
body: This ORANGE Level 2 lesson develops practical sales and marketing competency in Customer Lifetime Value: Why the First Sale Isn't the Whole Story. Learners should connect the concept to customer behaviour, positioning, acquisition economics, conversion, retention and measurable business outcomes. The objective is to make evidence-based marketing and sales decisions, distinguish useful metrics from vanity metrics, and apply ethical persuasion without manipulation. Examples should be adapted to the relevant market, customer segment and regulatory environment.
